sentences.text:
Suraj Ratan Agarwal & Anr vs State Of Rajasthan & Anr on 24
April, 2015

Author: Vijay Bishnoi
Bench: Vijay Bishnoi
 1
 S.B. Criminal Misc. Petition No.2468/2011
 Suraj Ratan Agarwal & Anr.
 V/S
 State of Rajasthan & Anr.
 Date of Order : 24.04.2015
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vijay Bishnoi
Mr M.S. Purohit, for petitioners.

This criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer for quashing the complaint dated 06.02.2004 filed against the petitioners in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bikaner (hereinafter referred to as 'the trial court') for the offence punishable under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and for quashing the criminal proceedings of the Criminal Regular Case No.95/2004 pending in the trial court.

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bikaner
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: After attempting to argue the matter on merits for quite some time, learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that he does not want to press this criminal misc. petition, however, seeks liberty for the petitioners to raise all their arguments before the trail court at the time of framing of charges.
It is also prayed by learned counsel for the petitioners that the trial court be directed to expedite the proceedings of Criminal Regular Case No.95/2004.
Learned Public Prosecutor has no objection if such liberty is granted to the petitioners.
Hence, this criminal misc. petition is dismissed as not pressed with the liberty as prayed for.

However, the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bikaner is directed to expedite the proceedings of Criminal Regular Case No.95/2004.
Stay petition also stands dismissed.
[VIJAY BISHNOI],J.
